phase_history.notes: Fixed 'selecting a model does not update the EQ curve' (regression from the custom dropdown). Root cause: on item mousedown the input blurred and the blur handler closed the panel (display:none) before mouseup, so WebKitGTK/WebView2 both suppressed the item click event -> selectModel never ran -> input stayed empty and no curve appeared. Fixed by selecting on pointerdown (fires before blur) with a primary-button guard. Verified with a WebKitWebDriver harness that loads the real production modules (js/index.js, js/juce/*) behind a faithful __JUCE__ stub: real click selects the model, valueChanged reaches the backend, curve draws and overlay hides; 7/7 dropdown tests pass including a new real-click regression test. Also hardened: without a delivered propertiesChanged (hidden-at-construction editor) the emitted value stays in [0,1] and C++ clamps to index 0 - flagged as latent, not user-facing.

Replaced native <datalist> with a custom CSS dropdown (dropdown-panel/dropdown-item classes) so the list renders identically across WebView2/WebKitGTK/WKWebView and matches the neubrutalism palette. List autopopulates on focus/click; type-to-filter (prefix-priority, 200-item render cap), keyboard nav (up/down/home/end/enter/esc), hover/click select, blur + outside-click close. Added generator-synthesized 'No Model Selected' neutral entry at index 0 (preamp 0 + 10 unity PK stages) so the plugin applies no correction until a headphone is chosen; dataset now 6034 entries. JS MODEL_COUNT-derived normalisation already in place. Saved-state indices shift +1 (final reorder).

Replaced oratory1990-only dataset with AutoEq 'Recommended Results' (results/README.md): 736 -> 6033 models, one highest-accuracy measurement per headphone. generate_data.py now parses the recommended list, pads sub-10-filter profiles with unity PK stages, and tolerates stale case in upstream links. Verified 733/736 shared models byte-identical; 3 replaced by higher-accuracy sources (Bose QC20 x2 -> Innerfidelity, CX 400BT -> Rtings). ATH-M30 added (crinacle EARS+711, index 629). JS MODEL_COUNT magic number removed (derived from init data). Caveat: saved sessions store model as index, so old states may remap post-reorder.
Preset-based corrective EQ using oratory1990 headphone curves.
Complexity 2/5. DSP: biquad IIR chain from ParametricEQ.txt data.
Single-pass implementation. WebView neubrutalism UI, 10-biquad filter chain, 96 KB embedded preset data.
Linux VST3+Standalone distribution (5.4 MB tarball). LV2 requires display env.

Fixed WebView so UI renders in REAPER/standalone. Root causes: (1) JUCE linux CommandReceiver wrote char count instead of UTF-8 byte count, truncating the init message (2) getResource returned index.html for every sub-resource because fromFirstOccurrenceOf returns empty when the bare path lacks the backend root, so all ES modules failed with 'Unexpected token <'. Models init data flattened (736 per-name entries) so the datalist populates. Verified standalone: modules load, modelsLen=736, updateCurve/updateModelInfo defined.

Fixed silent wet path and model selection. Root causes: (1) preset stage gains are stored in dB but were passed directly as the linear gainFactor to IIR::Coefficients::makePeakFilter/makeLowShelf/makeHighShelf; any cut (negative dB) produced NaN coefficients and total silence. Fixed with Decibels::decibelsToGain. (2) APVTS getRawParameterValue('model') returns the denormalised value (already the 0..735 index), but processBlock and the editor timer multiplied it by 735 as if it were [0,1], so every non-zero model loaded preset 735 and the graph only ever pushed model 0. Fixed by treating the raw value as the index. Also removed the editor's isVisible timer gate and added an earwareReady handshake (C++ withEventListener + JS emitEvent) plus a DOMContentLoaded guard so the search bar no longer flashes the first model on window reopen. Verified headlessly with earware_rendertest (real processor, 44.1kHz): bypass is unity gain, every model is audible and distinct, outputs match independent RBJ predictions. Re-packaged dist binaries.

framework_selection.rationale: WebView enables rich neubrutalism styling (CSS dot grid, hard borders, canvas curve) and a searchable dropdown with 736 items that would be tedious in native C++. The visual design demands HTML/JS flexibility. Platform deps (WebView2 runtime on Windows, webkit2gtk on Linux) are manageable.
